propositions: Neutral core modules (outbound_comments.py, inbound_translate.py) contain literal lazy-load keys that unconditionally load Jira-specific adapter modules regardless of configured backend
Comment formatting, ADF decoding, and truncation currently route through vendor-specific modules via lazy keys instead of backend-abstracted port methods
The FieldSanitizer and InboundMapper port roles must expose fit_comment and normalize_rich_text methods respectively to serve outbound and inbound rich-text handling without vendor hard-coding

The three deleted literal keys (_ADF_KEY, _COMMENT_LIMITS_KEY, _ADF_KEY_APPLIER) and their lazy-load infrastructure must be removed from core, with _normalize_adf_body re-implemented to route through the port
A sweep gate test verifies no core package-root module (except inbound_fields.py) contains the jira adapter literal string, ensuring vendor code does not execute on neutral paths
